newsitem.title: USA: Spelling in license deal with KirchGroup.
newsitem.headline: Spelling in license deal with KirchGroup.

text.p: Spelling Entertainment Group Inc and German Media Group KirchGroup said Monday they had entered into a television licensing agreement.
Under the agreement, KirchGroup has licensed Spelling's library for the German-language territory for free and pay television, pay per view, and near video on demand.

KirchGroup has also licensed in the German-language territory certain television rights to mini-series and television series and certain feature films to be produced by Spelling, including Spelling Television, Big Ticket Television Inc and Spelling Films Inc, as well as television rights in Continental Europe for new made-for-television movies produced by these companies.
The agreement has an initial five-year term that can be extended for another five years.
Spelling is a majority-owned subsidiary of Viacom Inc.
